DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二泊ですが、一泊ずつ別に予約しました。同じ部屋にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別予約の連泊で同室を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm staying two nights, but booked each night separately. Can I have the same room?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request the same room in Japanese for consecutive nights booked separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの予約番号をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have both reservation numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。日付は続いていますが、部屋の種類は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号と異なる部屋種類を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The dates are consecutive, but the room types differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State both reservation numbers and explain in Japanese that the room types are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が空きと条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check availability and conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 続く日付だけで同室と決めず、差額も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同室確約とせず差額を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume consecutive dates mean the same room; I'd like to ask the price difference too.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the price difference without treating the same room as guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更が難しければ部屋移動になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: If a change is difficult, you will need to move rooms.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その場合、二日目の荷物を預ける方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動時の荷物預けを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: In that case, please tell me how to store my luggage on the second day.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about luggage storage when changing rooms.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 費用と移動時刻をまとめて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the fees and moving time together.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから決めます。片方を先に取り消さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明前の取消を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after the explanation. Please don't cancel one booking first.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to hold off cancellation until after the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両予約を維持したまま、同室可否と代案を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Staff will explain same-room availability and alternatives while keeping both bookings.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。四個のパンを、二個ずつ二袋にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四個を二袋に分ける希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Could you split four buns into two bags of two?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for four buns divided into two bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払いも二つに分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like two separate payments too?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払いは私がまとめます。袋だけ分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋分割と一括支払を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll pay for everything together. I only want the items put in separate bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish separate bags from combined payment in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋ごとの商品を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the items for each bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それぞれ甘いパン一個と食事用一個です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋ごとの商品構成を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: One sweet bun and one savory bread in each.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify each bag's contents in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの組合せでよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。同僚と別に帰るので、二袋とも中身を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別行動のため両袋を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My coworker and I are going home separately, so I'll check both bags' contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check both bags because you will go separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取のお名前を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: May I have the collection name?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: リンです。同僚の名義に注文を増やさず、この四個でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取名と追加なしの数量を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Linh. Please keep it to these four without adding an order in my coworker's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the collection name and quantity without additions in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: リン様の四個を二袋に分け、会計は一件でお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll divide Linh's four items into two bags and take one payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の写真に、隣の方のロッカー札が写りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 私的写真への他人の札の写込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: The locker tag of the person beside me appeared in a photo I took for my own use.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that someone else's tag appears in your private photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公開や送信はしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you published or sent it?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。切り取ればよいと決めず、扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送信で加工だけでは判断しないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Rather than decide cropping solves it, I'd like advice on handling it.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is unsent and you won't decide based only on editing.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撮影場所とルールを担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check the location and photography rules.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 着替える場所ではありませんが、ここで許可されるかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所と撮影許可を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: It wasn't a changing area, but I'll also check whether photography is permitted here.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the location and photography permission in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 他の利用者の番号は見せ広げないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not share other users' numbers with others.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要な写真だけ担当へ見せ、友人へは送りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な範囲だけ担当へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show only the necessary photo to staff and won't send it to friends.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show staff only what is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認までは追加の撮影を止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until confirmation, please stop taking additional photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。公開せず、保存した画像の扱いも案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加撮影を止め画像の扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't publish it, and I'll ask about handling the saved image too.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stop further photography and ask how to handle the image.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未公開の写真と撮影場所の相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。今は撮影をお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass this on as an inquiry about an unpublished photo and its shooting location. Please refrain from photography now.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業を始める前に担当を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Check the person responsible before beginning work.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 笛が聞こえましたが、隣の区画の合図かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別区画の合図か不明と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard a whistle, but it might have been a signal for the neighboring section.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you are unsure whether the signal belongs to another section.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 自分の区画の指示を受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you received instructions for your own section?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。音だけで資材を動かしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自区画の指示未受領で作業を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I won't move materials based on the sound alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have no instructions for your section and will hold work.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の担当者と作業表を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check today's person responsible and work sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 作業表は持っています。資材の運搬担当と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作業表の担当を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the sheet. It says I'm responsible for transporting materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your assignment on the work sheet in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 経路には別の班の作業があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Another team is working on the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通行の合図と作業開始の合図も分けて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行と作業開始の合図を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to hear separately about the passage signal and work-start signal too.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check passage signals separately from work-start signals in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 責任者が二つの区画の連絡方法を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: The supervisor will explain communication between the two sections.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明後に自分の担当の指示を復唱します。今は待機します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 責任者説明後に指示を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: After the explanation, I'll repeat the instructions for my assignment. For now I'll wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will repeat instructions after the supervisor's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのまま指定の待機場所でお待ちください。責任者確認後に、この区画の指示を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep waiting at the designated place. After the supervisor confirms, we'll give this section's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 氏名欄でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the name field?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前が長く、最後の二文字が入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氏名末尾が欄に収まらないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is long, and the final two characters won't fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the end of your name will not fit in the field.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人確認書類にはどうありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: How does your identification show it?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 全体が載っています。短くせず見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 省略なしの本人書類を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: My full name is shown on it. Please check it without shortening my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your unabridged identification details in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表記方法を担当へ確認します。既に送信しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask staff how to write it. Have you already submitted?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。省略した入力で申し込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 省略入力の送信を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I won't apply with an abbreviated entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hold off submitting an entry with your name shortened.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面の表示だけか、登録欄の制限か調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll investigate whether this is only screen display or a registration-field limit.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示が切れたのかも不明です。入力内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示と登録の制限を区別して確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't know whether the display is just cut off either. I'd like to check the entered content.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese a check distinguishing display from registration limits.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の書類と入力画面を合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the original document together with the input screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。呼び名と正式な氏名は別に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 呼称と正式氏名を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I'll give my preferred form of address separately from my official full name.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish your preferred name from your official full name in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未送信の申込として引き継ぎます。正式な氏名の登録方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hand this over as an unsubmitted application. We'll explain how to register your official full name.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出口の案内でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先に外へ出たいのですが、同行者が改札内で私のスーツケースを持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物が改札内の同行者にあることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to go outside first, but my companion has my suitcase inside the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your luggage is with a companion inside the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同行者の方とは、どこで合流する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where do you plan to meet your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じホームの階段前です。私だけ出ると、荷物を受け取るために戻ることになりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 合流場所と先に出る問題を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: In front of the stairs on the same platform. If I leave alone, it seems I'd need to return to collect my luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the meeting place and problem of leaving first in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら先に合流した方がよさそうですね。目的の出口は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then meeting first sounds better. Do you know the exit you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 南側の出口です。ただ、ホームから階段を上がった後の分かれ道が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 南出口までの分岐を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The south exit. But I don't know the junction after going up the platform stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the turn toward the south exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内図では階段を上がって右が南側です。大きい荷物ならエレベーターも使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this map, south is right after the stairs. For large luggage you can use the elevator too.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を受け取ってからエレベーターにします。階段前から乗り場まではどう進みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物受取後のエレベーター経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use the elevator after collecting my luggage. How do I get from the stairs to its entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the elevator route after collecting your luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 階段前を通り過ぎ、ホーム奥のエレベーター表示へ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Go past the front of the stairs and toward the elevator sign farther down the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に同行者へ場所を伝え、合流して荷物を持ってから南側へ出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流と受取を済ませてから出口へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll first tell my companion the place, meet and take my luggage, then leave on the south side.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will meet and collect luggage before heading for the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。先に改札を出ず、荷物を受け取ってからお二人で表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Don't go through the gates first; collect the luggage and check the signs together.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真の場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the place in the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この写真の川の景色を撮りたいですが、同じ橋でも建物が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 橋の写真と建物が見えない方向差を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to photograph this river view, but even on the same bridge, I can't see the building.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the direction difference between the bridge photo and your view without the building.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真はどちらの方向を向いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which way is the photograph facing?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は川下を向いています。写真の建物は川上側かもしれませんが、自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在川下向きと写真方向未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm facing downstream now. The building in the photo might be upstream, but I don't know myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you face downstream and the photo's direction is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この写真は川上側を背景にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This photo uses the upstream side as its background.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では向く方向を変えます。橋の反対側へ急に道路を横切らず、歩道の経路を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 川上へ向く移動で道路横断を避ける経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll change direction. Rather than suddenly cross the road to the other side of the bridge, I'd like the pedestrian route.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a route to face upstream without suddenly crossing the road.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いったん橋を渡り、先の横断する場所から移れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Cross the bridge first, then change sides at the crossing farther ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真と同じ立ち位置にこだわらず、通れる経路で見える所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同立位置より通れる経路で撮影地点を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't insist on the exact photo position; I'll find a view along a route I'm allowed to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose a photo spot along a route you can use, rather than insist on standing in exactly the same place.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人の流れが多い時は止まる場所にもご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When many people are passing, be careful where you stop too.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。撮る前に横へ寄り、川上側の建物が写るか確かめます。ほかの人の通行を止めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影前に脇へ寄り景色と通行を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll move aside before photographing and check whether the upstream building appears. I won't stop other people from passing.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will move aside and check the view and passage before taking photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 先の経路から歩道側を移れます。景色の方向と安全に立てる場所を分けてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You can change sidewalk sides using the route ahead. Choose the view direction separately from where you can stand safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about photographs?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜景を撮ると、後ろの照明と自分の顔が窓に写ります。少し場所を変えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜景写真の反射と場所変更希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I photograph the night view, the lights behind me and my face reflect in the window. May I change position a little?
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the night-photo reflections and wish to change location in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三脚などはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a tripod or similar equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、携帯だけです。窓に物を貼ったり、照明を消したりするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯のみで設備を変えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, just my phone. I don't intend to stick anything on the window or turn off the lights.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have only a phone and won't alter the facilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 奥の窓際の方が室内の光が入りにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The windows farther inside pick up less indoor light.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥へ移ります。ほかの人の顔が写らないよう、空いている窓を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人の写り込みを避ける窓を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move farther in. I'll choose an empty window so other people's faces don't appear.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose a window where other people will not appear in your photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同行者の方も一緒に移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will your companion move with you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私が先に撮り始めると見失うので、先に移る場所を二人で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者と移動先を先に共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If I start photographing first, we'll lose each other, so we'll confirm the place we're moving to together first.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share your destination with your companion before moving in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路側には荷物を置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't put luggage on the passage side.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物は持ったまま短く撮り、写り込みが残っても設備には触れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を持ち設備に触れず撮影すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll hold my belongings and take photos briefly; even if reflections remain, I won't touch the facilities.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will carry your belongings and photograph without touching the facilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。奥の窓は右側です。撮影中も周りの通行にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. The window farther in is on the right. Be aware of people passing while taking photos too.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の受診で、説明の補助が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help understanding explanations at today's appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語の説明を友人に手伝ってもらいますが、友人は三十分後に仕事へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳役の友人が同席できる時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend will help me with Japanese explanations, but they have to return to work in thirty minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese how long your interpreting friend can attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察時間はまだ確定していません。ご自身で特に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The consultation time isn't fixed yet. Is there anything you especially want to check yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい薬の飲み方です。友人が帰った後でも、間違えずに飲める説明が欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察後も分かる薬の説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: How to take the new medicine. I'd like an explanation that lets me take it correctly even after my friend leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese medicine instructions you can understand after the appointment too.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お薬の内容は診察担当が判断します。説明をメモで残す希望は伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The clinician will decide the medication. We can pass on your wish for written notes of the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。飲む回数と時間、今の薬と一緒に飲むかを、分けて書いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 服用回数と併用の説明を分けて依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I'd like the frequency and times, and whether to take it together with my current medicine, written separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request separate explanations of dose frequency and combined use in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人の方に、診察内容を共有してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: May we share the consultation information with your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、今日の薬の説明は共有してよいです。関係のない過去の相談まで全部伝える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人への情報共有範囲を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, today's medicine explanation may be shared. There's no need to tell them all my unrelated past consultations.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese the scope of information shared with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その範囲を担当へ伝えます。現在のお薬の情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell staff that scope. Do you have information about your current medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お薬手帳を持っています。友人の時間内に終わる保証は求めず、帰った後の説明方法も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手帳を提示し友人退出後の説明方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my medicine record book. I'm not requesting a guarantee we'll finish within my friend's available time; I'd like to discuss how explanations will work after they leave too.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the record book and ask in Japanese about explanations after your friend departs.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 手帳をお預かりします。共有範囲と書面説明の希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take the book. I'll pass on the sharing scope and request for written explanation to the clinician.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日ここへ財布を届けました。拾った場所について、あとから目印を思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得物の場所について追加情報があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I handed in a wallet here yesterday. Later I remembered a landmark for where I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have additional information about the found item's location.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付の控えをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the receipt from the report?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この番号です。昨日は公園の入口とだけ伝えましたが、入口が二つあることに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号と入口の曖昧さを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this number. Yesterday I only said the park entrance, but realized there are two entrances.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the report number and explain the ambiguous entrance in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちらの入口だったか説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you explain which entrance it was?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤いベンチのある側です。道路側の入口ではなく、川沿いの通路から入った所でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチと川沿いの位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The side with the red bench. Not the road-side entrance, but where you enter from the riverside path.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the bench and riverside position in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った時間についても変更がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there also a change to the time you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時間は昨日伝えたままです。追加したいのは入口の位置だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更する情報が位置だけと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The time is as I reported yesterday. Only the entrance location is what I want to add.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clarify in Japanese that only the location information is changing.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ追加情報を伝えます。財布の持ち主とは連絡を取っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on the additional information. Have you been in contact with the wallet's owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いいえ、取っていません。持ち主を自分で探すより、届けた記録へ正確な情報を追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録への追加を依頼し自分で持ち主を探さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. Rather than look for the owner myself, I'd like to add accurate information to the record I submitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the record addition and say in Japanese that you won't search for the owner yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付番号にひもづけて担当へ伝えます。必要な確認があれば、控えの連絡先へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect it to the report number and tell staff. If further checks are needed, we'll contact you using the details on the receipt.
